title: RBI Imposes penalty on Bank of Baroda for Fair Practices Code violations
source_url: Not directly available in search results
description: <cite index="17-4,17-5,17-7">Bank of Baroda was fined ₹63.6 lakh for non-compliance with provisions of the Fair Practices Code for Lenders and Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines, with supervisory findings showing the bank had charged interest above the contracted rate in certain loan accounts</cite>.
